summary: The figure shows mortality rates attributed to unsafe WASH services and the cumulative share of deaths by WHO region in 2019. The African Region has the highest mortality rate (~46 per 100,000 population) and contributes about 37% of cumulative deaths. South-East Asia and Eastern Mediterranean Regions follow with lower mortality rates but higher cumulative shares of deaths. The European Region has the lowest mortality rate (~3) and completes the cumulative share to 100%.
